models.notes: Origin at trunk base (z=0, roots dip 0.1 m under). Lush broadleaf tree ~9 m, canopy radius ~4 m. Materials: bark, bark_dark, leaf_dark/leaf/leaf_light (tintable via 'leaf'), fruit (emissive pink dots). Foliage leaf cards are two-sided geometry.

Origin at trunk base. Weeping umbrella tree ~7 m with flat tiered canopy (~5 m wide), sunset palette (crimson/orange/amber) + small emissive blossoms. Materials: bark, bark_dark, leaf_dark/leaf/leaf_light (tintable 'leaf'), blossom (emissive).
Origin at trunk base. Tall layered conifer ~14 m, 14 star-shaped drooping skirts (tier radius 3.2 m at the bottom). Materials: bark, bark_dark, leaf_dark/leaf/leaf_light (tintable 'leaf'), cone.
Origin at ground centre. Cluster of 7 flowers with emissive petals (petal_a pink, petal_b cyan; tintable 'petal') and glowing yellow cores, ~0.5 m. Two-sided petals/leaves.

Origin at trunk base. Dark twisted crystalline trunk with 6 translucent crystal branches (alpha 0.55, emissive) + opaque emissive inner cores (core). Materials: trunk, crystal_a (cyan), crystal_b (magenta) [tintable 'crystal'], core (emissive 6.0). Flat shaded. ~7 m.

Origin at the centre of the buttress/stilt-root hub at ground level (z=0). Gnarled swamp tree ~8 m with 7 arching stilt roots (reach ~2.9 m), mossy bark, drooping foliage clumps, hanging vines/moss beards and bioluminescent glow bulbs (glow, emissive 3.5). Collider covers the trunk only.

Origin at ground centre. 26 two-sided reed blades (1.1-2.1 m, a few dry) + 5 cattail spikes (cattail). Materials: reed, reed_tip, reed_dry [tintable 'reed'], cattail, stem. Intended for swamp shores / MultiMesh.
Origin at ground centre. Rosette of 11 arching fronds with two-sided leaflets (3 green tones, dark base -> light tips; tintable 'leaf') + 2 fiddleheads, ~1.6 m wide.

Origin at trunk base. Palm leaning towards +X (Godot +X) by ~2 m at the crown, ~8.4 m tall; ringed trunk (trunk/trunk_ring alternate), 13 feathery drooping fronds (frond/frond_dark [tintable 'frond'], rachis), 6 coconuts. Collider is only the lower trunk.

Origin at ground centre. Blue-grey rock (rock, rock_dark) with branching staghorn corals (coral_a orange, coral_b pink), brain coral and tube corals / sea fan (coral_c purple) and small emissive cyan polyps/tips (glow 2.6). ~3 m wide, ~2 m high. Collider: use sphere/box around the rock mass.

Origin at the base centre. ~6 m spiral horn (2-lobed helical ridges, 1.5 turns, cream/violet stripes via horn_a/horn_b) with a golden emissive tip (glow, 5.0), 4 satellite horns 2-3.7 m, teal sheath leaves (sheath, sheath_b) and a few floating glow spores. The main horn leans to +X.

Origin = lowest point (root tips) at z=0 directly under the island centre; the island itself floats ~1-3 m above (the game should hover it: y_offset as needed). ~6 m wide, ~6 m tall incl. crystals. Collider cylinder spans y = 2.5 .. 5.5 (the rock mass); crystals/roots have no collider. Materials: rock, grass, leaf, root, crystal (translucent, emissive 2.5), core (emissive 6).

Origin at ground centre. Lush leafy shrub ~1.25 m high, ~2 m wide: ~230 overlapping two-sided folded leaf cards around a hidden dark core, 7 woody stems, clustered emissive pink berries. Materials: stem, leaf_dark/leaf/leaf_light (tintable 'leaf'), berry (emissive).

Origin at ground centre. Two-sided grass blades (18 arching blades: 9 tall + 9 short, 3 tone materials blade / blade_mid / blade_tip from dark base to light tip), ~0.6 m. Intended for MultiMesh scattering; tint via 'blade' materials.

Origin at the bulb base. 10 giant accordion-folded fan leaves (flat shaded, two-sided) on purple petioles; teal/blue stripes with emissive magenta rim (edge), glowing orange bloom spike (glow, emissive 4.0) poking ~0.4 m above the leaf crown. Leaf crown ~5.4 m, total ~5.6 m tall, ~5.3 m wide.
